title: Open Duet - self-hosted AI coworker agents with human approval
content:
Claude Duet jaisi always-on AI coworker
products ki baat suni hogi.
Open Duet uska open-source, SELF-HOSTED
alternative framing hai.

Repo hai Anil-matcha slash open-duet on GitHub.
Idea ye hai: named AI agents with
instructions, memory, routines,
apna isolated computer, aur action se pehle
aapki APPROVAL.
Ye Claude Duet, aur similar always-on agent
products ke alternative ke taur pe framed
hai.
Status EXPERIMENTAL hai, desktop plus
single-owner server.

Important detail. Isme model ya subscription
INCLUDE NAHI HAI.
Aap apna engine laate ho.
Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenRouter,
OpenAI-compatible, whatever you already use.
So the product is the agent team shell, not
another closed model bill.

Har agent ke paas clear instructions ho sakte hain.
Memory. Routines. Isolated computer.
Aur critical part: APPROVAL before they act.
Matlab agent research kar sakta hai, draft
kar sakta hai,
lekin risky action pe human gate lagta hai.

Ab career angle, practical skill of
designing agent teams.
Hiring managers AI SOLUTIONS ENGINEER roles
mein ye poochhenge:
can you design an AGENT TEAM WITH HUMAN APPROVAL?
Not just one chatbot. A small team with
roles and gates.
That is the skill companies will pay for as
agents leave demos and enter real workflows.

Maan lo aap 3 agents design karte ho.
Ek research kare. Ek CRM notes update kare.
Ek draft likhe.
Teeno approval se pehle ruk jayein jab email
send ya payment jaisi cheez aaye.
That design skill transfers to any stack,
Open Duet ho ya company internal tools.
Aap tools change kar sakte ho. The approval
habit stays.

Reminder: ye EXPERIMENTAL hai.
Production pe blind trust mat karo.
Apne machine pe try karo, permissions tight
rakho, aur pehle read-only tasks do.
Start with research and drafts only. Add
send tools later, after you trust the gates.

Mera take simple hai.
Models commodity ho rahe hain.
Jo log agent teams aur approval gates design
karna seekh lenge,
wahi AI Solutions Engineer interviews mein
stand out karenge.

Comment DUET and I'll DM you the GitHub link.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
